description: Address review findings: SQLite cursor concurrency, ARP sweep timing, NTLM bind interface, VLANScanner public wait method, _packets_processed lock, _parse_cidr dedup, hccapx message pair derivation, HTTPS stale iptables cleanup, auto-pivot world-readable credentials
steps: Fix database.py: Add connection-level lock around all cursor.execute calls for thread safety
Fix vlan_scanner.py: Overlap sniff and send in arp_scan_vlan; add public wait_for_completion method; protect _packets_processed with _lock
Fix network_mapper.py: Overlap sniff and send in _arp_sweep; remove duplicate _parse_cidr by importing from shared utility
Fix ntlm_capture.py: Bind SMB server to specific interface IP instead of 0.0.0.0; protect _packets_processed with _lock
Fix orchestrator.py: Use public wait_for_completion method instead of accessing VLANScanner._sniff_thread
Fix handshake.py: Derive message pair value from actual captured messages instead of hardcoding 0
Fix https_intercept.py: Add startup check to remove stale iptables rules before adding new ones
Fix auto_pivot.py: Set os.chmod(config_path, 0o600) on wpa_supplicant config file
Create posframework/net_utils.py: Shared _parse_cidr utility to eliminate duplication
acceptance_criteria: database.py: All cursor.execute calls are protected by a lock
vlan_scanner.py: ARP scan sniffs concurrently with sending; has wait_for_completion() public method; _packets_processed accessed under _lock
network_mapper.py: ARP sweep sniffs concurrently with sending; uses shared _parse_cidr
ntlm_capture.py: SMB server binds to interface IP, not 0.0.0.0; _packets_processed under _lock
handshake.py: hccapx message pair derived from actual captured messages
https_intercept.py: Stale iptables rules cleaned up on start()
auto_pivot.py: wpa_supplicant config file has 0o600 permissions
All modified files pass ast.parse validation
findings: All 9 fixes implemented and verified. 67 Python files pass ast.parse. Created shared net_utils.py to eliminate code duplication. Database lock wraps all cursor operations (setup, insert/update, query, commit). ARP sweeps now start a background sniff thread before sending to capture early replies. NTLM SMB server uses get_interface_ip() to bind to specific interface. Orchestrator uses public wait_for_completion() API. Message pair in hccapx derived from actual captured EAPOL messages. HTTPS interceptor cleans up stale iptables on start. Auto-pivot config gets 0o600 permissions.
